title: PGC Reference Implementation: Conformance Workloads (conformance_workloads)
description:
Workloads that demonstrate a Profiled Normative Platform conforms to the Open PGC Standard. Exercised as evidence rather than as application code.

Part of the Protocol-Governed Computing reference corpus. Cite the version DOI of the release you used, not the concept DOI.
notes: Implements or supports the Open PGC Standard (10.5281/zenodo.22150616). Version is taken from the GitHub release tag; do not hard-code it here.
